adjudicated.en: It's Sunday so I have the alarm clock set for ten AM, but,
comments: It can be true as much as he wants, but it wasn't the alarm clock that woke him, wasn't it? In fact, it's never heard outside of CCA0004. Ever. The sound effect is exclusive to that script. The batteries can't have run out in just a week, can they? Regardless, the lie remains careful: just because he has the alarm clock set to 10AM doesn't mean it's 10AM *now*. It's far more interesting to wonder why lie about it at this point. -GHS

adjudicated.jp: 丸々一時間、美希とちゅーをしていた。
adjudicated.en: for one whole hour I smooched with Miki.
comments: And there's further evidence: it would now be 11. That's impossible, as the loop would be in half an hour. It's no later than 8 as of now (7AM to 8AM...), which leaves Miki with 2 hours to go back and forth from the hokora, and an hour-half for extras. ...not that the loop is necessarily fixed, because it's all in Taichi's head, but I do believe these lines are there to wake readers up that bigger misleads are starting up. -GHS
